subject.title: [Feature]: Auto-inject SKILL.md content when skill is invoked via slash command

question: Should explicit non-tool skill slash commands automatically inject SKILL.md content into model context, and what instruction authority and isolation boundary should that content have?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but turning slash-invoked skills from advisory model text into guaranteed context changes prompt authority and handling of potentially untrusted skill instructions.

options.title: Define Guarded Core Injection
options.body: Implement slash-invoked SKILL.md loading only after maintainers define untrusted-content delimiters, precedence rules, compatibility behavior, docs, and regression tests.

options.title: Prefer a Skill/Tool Route
options.body: Route explicit skill slash commands through a dedicated Skill-style tool or router contract instead of hidden prompt injection, preserving a tool-mediated boundary.

options.title: Keep Advisory Routing
options.body: Document the current model-routed behavior as intentional and direct deterministic workflows to `command-dispatch: tool` or future plugin APIs.

recommendation.title: Define Guarded Core Injection
recommendation.body: Implement slash-invoked SKILL.md loading only after maintainers define untrusted-content delimiters, precedence rules, compatibility behavior, docs, and regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the user-invocable skill command surface and has the strongest current history signal on the prompt and slash-command code paths.
